_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 57: 2-8 March 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of war breaking out with Israel and Iran in the days ahead, and says he told them back in January that he saw an American missile striking a mountain that was an underground city, with Iran setting all kinds of deterrence to try to stop it, and that it was very powerful.
mentions.quote: I saw American missile striking a mountain that was an underground city
mentions.falsify_match: A strike on an underground Iranian facility. The January telling is in this corpus and can be read against this recall.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike, or the January telling does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi and Louisiana, over an attack against the water supply and the water purification plants and infrastructure, and refers to a tyrant who is a drug figure.
mentions.quote: praying over this area for attack against our water supply
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on water infrastructure in the Gulf states.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. Four named states with no date and no act, which is the recurring shape.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is dark over there and that is what the Lord was saying, that he did not know all this and told Brandon to start looking it up because it is pitch black and there are no lights, and that it will happen in the night.
mentions.quote: It's pitch black. There's no lights. It will happen in the night
mentions.falsify_match: A blackout used as cover for an operation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says he did not know the area was dark until it was looked up, which is worth recording: the detail was confirmed after the sight rather than before.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is on Cuba and on this area through cyber attacks, that he said some of this will last up to three weeks of darkness, and that he saw a major city.
mentions.quote: some of this will last up to three weeks darkness
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber-caused blackout lasting weeks.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Up to three weeks sets a ceiling rather than a floor, so any outage satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees something and tells them what he is seeing but is praying, works out that a word from June 25th of 2025 was seven or eight months ago, and is reminded that he always says he does not know why he keeps seeing Cuba.
mentions.quote: I don't know why I keep seeing Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: The June 2025 telling is in this corpus and can be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. He says outright he does not know why the country keeps appearing.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch Israel in the middle of the night, that he sees it again, that he is watching Israel in the middle of the night, and that it will be worse than October 7th.
mentions.quote: Watch Israel in the middle of the night. Worse than October 7th
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel exceeding 7 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Seventh telling since November, still with no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has an urgency and that he asked him what 2026 looks like, whether they are ready, whether they are prepared for what is about to happen, and whether the church is ready.
mentions.quote: What does this 2026 look like? Are we ready? Are we prepared?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a question about readiness rather than a claim about events.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a radical conversion to Jesus, says some plant and some water and God brings forth the increase, and that people have witnessed to him so the increase is coming.
mentions.quote: some plant, some water, and God, you said you'd bring forth the increase
mentions.falsify_match: A named person converting.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The person is not identified in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He reads the Ezekiel passage about prophesying to the wind so that breath comes from the four winds and the slain live, and says he got excited about it because he thought about whether these bones can live.
mentions.quote: I just got excited about it. Cuz I thought can these bones
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scripture read and applied, the basis for the dead-raised material.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes a frog in a pot getting hotter, notes it is already nineteen minutes and he is talking too much, and asks them to play the clip of what they talked about on March the 3rd when he gave this word.
mentions.quote: a frog in a pot getting hotter
mentions.falsify_match: The 3 March telling is in this corpus and is played on air, so it can be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are trying to put these fish back in the water, that they are coming from the depth, that there are so many of them, and asks them to read what it says.
mentions.quote: they're trying to put these fish back in the water
mentions.falsify_match: A reported mass appearance of deep-sea fish, which is the kind of story that circulates as an earthquake omen.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He offers a news item as the match rather than describing the sight first.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that they are healed and whole and well in their bodies and that everything they need is met, from their heart to the soles of their feet and their brain, whatever it may be.
mentions.quote: from their heart to the souls of their feet, their brain
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He dates something to July 2023, says the Lord is still talking to him about it again, and that he said to him there is going to be a great revival.
mentions.quote: There's going to be a great revival, Brandon
mentions.falsify_match: A documented revival. The July 2023 telling is near the start of this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None yet, nearly three years on, and the claim carries no date.

mentions.claim_text: He gives praise for a new month five days in, thanks God for March and that they are marching forward, and prays for great protection around the St Patrick's Day parade concerning Chicago, calling it strategic.
mentions.quote: the St. Patrick's Day parade for great protection around it concerning Chicago
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the Chicago St Patrick's Day parade.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. A named city, a named event and a fixed date, which is tighter than most.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for the word for the devices that make them fall, settles on drone jammers rather than scanners, and prays that the New York stadium and all the other open stadiums would have them because of drones being flown in.
mentions.quote: drone jammers. That New York stadium would have it
mentions.falsify_match: A drone incident at an open stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Extends the November drone claim from European holiday crowds to American stadiums.

mentions.claim_text: He says the decisions he makes over the next couple of weeks will make or break his presidency, whether he lives and goes through it or he goes home, and recalls telling them about open doors when most people thought otherwise.
mentions.quote: whether he lives and goes through it or he goes home
mentions.falsify_match: The president dying or leaving office within weeks.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. This is a serious escalation on the make-or-break language: goes home now means death, on a three week clock.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of how he feels going into the Fourth of July from now until then, praying over their churches and gatherings and over the nation for the 250th anniversary parades and military parades, for a shock attack.
mentions.quote: the 250th anniversary parades, military parades and things like that
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a 250th anniversary event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note he has elsewhere ruled the obvious 4 July date out, and here prays over it anyway.

mentions.claim_text: He says the rats they injected, which the Chinese government is playing with, carry the most deadly thing and it is a hundred percent fatality, asks them to play a clip, and says they are not trying to scare them.
mentions.quote: the most deadly and it's 100% fatality
mentions.falsify_match: A pathogen with a hundred percent case fatality rate.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A hundred percent fatality would be unprecedented, and it sits against plague-350m where a fixed death toll implies survivors.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are looking in the mirror and asks what about them, whether they are all right with the Lord, whether they know him, that they may know a lot about him but asks whether he knows them, and repeats that it is appointed unto man once to die.
mentions.quote: You may know a lot about him, but do you know him?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He tells praying mothers and fathers to anoint their children regardless of what they say, that they may get mad, and that they could do it while they are sleeping.
mentions.quote: I'm going to anoint you regardless. you could do it when they're sleeping
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it advises doing it without the person's knowledge.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the January word about an American missile striking a mountain that was an underground city with Iran setting deterrence against it, and says that when Israel does this he saw them set Iran back financially and nuclearly.
mentions.quote: I saw that they set Iran back financially, nuclear
mentions.falsify_match: A strike setting the Iranian nuclear programme back.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike. Adds the outcome, which the January telling did not carry.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be packed full when it happens and they will not be able to find a room, that people are hungry for authentic and want a fresh move of God that is not fake, that they want heaven invading earth, and to get ready because it is coming.
mentions.quote: It will be packed full when it happens
mentions.falsify_match: Overflow attendance at revival meetings, which would be visible.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not fill. No date, which is the limit.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows what he has seen but also knows what the word says concerning their protection and being in the right place at the right time, and notes he does not know how many of them are from around the world.
mentions.quote: I know what I've seen, but I know what the word says concerning our protection
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the sight and the exemption held together, which is the Psalm 91 move.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He checks that he is saying it right and speaks of lone wolf sympathizers, says this is what he talks about, that this is not the main show, and asks whether they will be patient and try to bring out their stupidity.
mentions.quote: lone wolf sympathizers. This is not the main show
mentions.falsify_match: Lone attacks followed by something larger.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Not the main show means any incident that does occur is a preliminary rather than the fulfilment, which defers the claim indefinitely.
